name: ChatGPT
short_description: Conversational intelligence model by OpenAI with voice, reasoning, and multimodal capabilities.
full_description: ChatGPT is OpenAI's flagship conversational AI system powered by GPT-4o and o1 reasoning models. Supports drafting, coding, file parsing, and multimodal conversational interaction.
source_attribution: OpenAI official documentation and public pricing page (https://openai.com/chatgpt/pricing)

name: Claude
short_description: Conversational and analytical assistant by Anthropic featuring Artifacts workspace and long context.
full_description: Claude is Anthropic's safety-focused conversational AI model powered by the Claude 3.5 Sonnet family. Capable of document analysis, coding, and side-by-side interactive Artifacts.

name: Cursor
short_description: AI-first code editor built on VS Code with codebase indexing and multi-file editing capabilities.
full_description: Cursor is an integrated developer environment engineered by Anysphere. Built on the VS Code engine, it embeds codebase indexing, terminal error debugging, and conversational code edits.
source_license: Proprietary with VS Code open-source core
source_attribution: Cursor official website and pricing documentation (https://cursor.com/pricing)

name: Perplexity AI
short_description: Conversational answer engine delivering cited research summaries from online sources.
full_description: Perplexity AI searches the open web and synthesizes answers with direct source citations, follow-up inquiry support, and file analysis capabilities.
source_attribution: Perplexity AI official pricing and statements (https://www.perplexity.ai/pro)

name: Midjourney
short_description: Text-to-image synthesis tool producing stylized imagery and creative visual concept art.
full_description: Midjourney is an independent research lab producing generative vision models. Accessible via Discord and web interface with controls for aspect ratio, style references, and region variations.
source_attribution: Midjourney official documentation and plan pricing (https://docs.midjourney.com/docs/plans)

name: ElevenLabs
short_description: AI voice generation and speech synthesis platform supporting multiple languages and voice cloning.
full_description: ElevenLabs develops speech synthesis and voice cloning models designed for content creators, audiobooks, dubbing, and interactive conversational agents.
source_attribution: ElevenLabs official product specifications and pricing (https://elevenlabs.io/pricing)

name: Runway Gen-3
short_description: Generative video platform generating motion clips from text, images, and camera controls.
full_description: Runway develops generative video synthesis tools. Its Gen-3 model creates video sequences from text prompts or still images with camera motion direction and creative styling.

name: Whisper
short_description: Open-source automatic speech recognition (ASR) neural net trained on multilingual speech data.
full_description: Whisper is an open-source neural network developed by OpenAI for speech recognition, transcription, and translation across dozens of languages. Licensed under the MIT License for local inference.

name: Stable Diffusion
short_description: Open-weights latent diffusion model for text-to-image generation and local pipeline inference.
full_description: Stable Diffusion is Stability AI's family of open generative vision models. Enables developers and artists to generate images locally or within specialized workflows like ComfyUI.
source_attribution: Stability AI official website and release documentation (https://stability.ai)

name: Descript
short_description: Audio and video editor centered around document-style transcript editing and voice isolation.
full_description: Descript enables creators to edit audio and video by modifying the corresponding text transcript. Includes noise removal, studio sound enhancement, and basic filler word removal.
